steps.en: Install Flower where your Celery app and broker URL are reachable
steps.zh: 在能触达 Celery 应用与 broker 的环境里装 Flower

steps.en: Point it at the cluster's broker and start the dashboard
steps.zh: 把它指向集群的 broker 并启动

steps.en: Joins the cluster's event feed and renders live worker and task state
steps.zh: 接入集群事件流，实时呈现 worker 与任务状态

steps.en: Drill in from the UI, or act via the REST API (revoke a task, grow a pool)
steps.zh: 在 UI 里下钻，或经 REST API 操作（撤销任务、扩池）

steps.en: Sends control commands over the broker and serves /metrics for Prometheus scraping
steps.zh: 控制指令走 broker，/metrics 供 Prometheus 抓取

value.en: A running Celery cluster becomes visible and operable from one web page, with no agent installed on any worker
value.zh: 一个 Celery 集群变得可看可控，只靠一张网页，worker 上零 agent
